title: Void Crevice
text: Entering a fissure removes half your current health and half the remaining durability of equipped armor and held items, rounded up. Remaining inside does not repeat the hit; leaving and entering again does.

After contact, a fissure attempts to relocate within nearby starflow or up to two blocks above its surface. A Spacetime Anchoring Sigil prevents the losses, not relocation. Mantas are immune, but their riders need their own sigil.
